mandatory_preferred.rule: Use conversion dilution plus interim coupons OR outstanding preferred claim; do not deduct full preferred principal after adding conversion shares.

sbc_rule: Choose explicit dilution/net tax settlements OR replacement-compensation cash charge with consistent awards accounting; cannot subtract all expenses and add all potential award shares mechanically. Diagnostic v1 haircut is not completed shareholder model.

tra.ri_taxes_basis: Before TRA tax benefits; adding full liability deduction to RI perpetuity without tax-benefit asset double counts cost.
tra.rule: Forecast actual tax savings and 85% TRA payments, or value paired tax asset/liability once.

earnouts.rule: Seller consideration is an existing acquisition claim; employee portion includes future service conditions. Separate existing accrued payables from future remuneration; forecast cash/equity settlement, avoiding another full deduction after modeled expense/dilution.

regulatory_rule: Required net assets are not all cash and are not incremental debt. No verified surplus cash after operating liquidity, restrictions and commitments.
postbalance_event: Announced October 26,2026; subject to transaction completion, expected first half 2027. Do not treat ARCC full $2.6bn EV as ARES debt.

carry_clawback_stress.at_current_fair_values: No material repayment obligation disclosed; stress is not current liability.
